source: match01.mp4 (EN, 1080p, no overlays), cross-checked on match02.mp4
notes: Boxes are [x0,y0,x1,y1] in 1920x1080 pixels. Measured from frames; roughly +-5 px. Text ROIs have extra margin for longer names (e.g. German). 'unverified' = seen only once or derived.

detect.hint: 'Select 4 Pokémon to send into battle.' / mode 'Ranked Battles  Double Battle'

opp_rows.note: Opponent preview shows NO names - only icon, type icons, gender. Species must come from icon matching (types as tie-breaker).

own_rows.note: Selected rows are lime with order digit 1-4 (1+2 = leads); unselected rows are dark blue.

field_bar.note: e.g. 'Electric Terrain 4/5'; appears top-left next to exit button

battle_text.note: single line, white with dark outline, no textbox, left aligned at x~300; fades in/out; long EN line ends ~x1440

ability_banner_own.note: Ability AND item trigger banner (same widget). Dark navy band across left side with icon at left: mon sprite + yellow chevron for abilities ('Raichu's / Electric Surge' t~104, 'Espathra's / Speed Boost'), item sprite for items ('Espathra's / Electric Seed' t104.5-106). NOT in battle_text line. A video model described it as a 'yellow pill' - frames show a navy band; the yellow is the chevron/item icon. Visible ~1.5-2 s, overlaps glow effects. line1 = '<Mon>'s', line2 = ability or item name -> classify via name lists (EN/DE).
ability_banner_own.detect_hint: navy band: mean B > R+40 in strip [150,385,640,395]; OCR line1/line2 only while band present

ability_banner_opp.note: verified match02: 'Noivern's / Focus Sash' t138, 'Froslass's / Snow Warning' t330. Mirrored navy band, icon on the RIGHT. Text is RIGHT-aligned (ends x~1762), icon x~1772-1847; band left of text adds noise ('-----') -> strip non-letters.

battle.plates_note: Plates are shown permanently only during command phase. During animations a single plate pops up at the SAME slot position when that mon is hit (seen for opp: t121 Blastoise 98%, t133 Clefable 65%, t169 Blastoise 0%). Read %/HP from every popup. | match01 timeline: plates are HIDDEN during move animations; only the plate of the mon being hit pops in for ~1.5 s and drains 100->93->89 (pct visible ~0.5-1 s after drain start). Read the settled value ~1 s after pop-in. Full set of plates is shown again at the command phase -> use that as the authoritative turn-start HP. Own hp ROI raw OCR often loses the current value ('/167', '7170' = '/170'); needs digit templates or 2x upscale + slash-split. | match02: after a KO with no replacement the fainted side shows a single plate (Raichu alone, T6).

command_menu.note: Active own mon to command is the plate with the glowing yellow outline (ownA or ownB).
command_menu.view_log_policy: NOT a data source (Jeremy 2026-11-15): tool must log fully automatically from the live image; the in-game View Log screen is only a content model for event types/wording. ROI kept only to recognise/ignore that screen if the player opens it.

move_select.note: Highlighted move = lime button + yellow arrow left of it (x~1290-1340). Own chosen move = highlighted move when screen changes to target_select or back to battle.

mega_toggle.note: Only shown when the active mon can Mega Evolve. 'MEGA EVOLVE' + [R]. Pressed state = icon glows with pink sparkles (t77.5 in match01). State reader still TBD (brightness/saturation in icon box).

move_select.note_eff: Effectiveness line only for damaging moves; status moves (Calm Mind, Protect...) have none.
move_select.note_anim: Move list slides in (t151/t309: only 2 of 4 rows visible) -> read only when all 4 button boxes are stable for >=2 frames.
move_select.note_eff_semantics: Eff line under each move refers to the default/hovered target; it also signals usability: Fake Out after turn 1 shows 'Has no effect' and selecting it gives battle_text 'This move can't be used!' (match02 t307).

target_select.note: Selected target card = lime fill + yellow arrow on its left. move_label points (tail) to the own mon that is choosing.
target_select.note2: Also shown for self/ally moves (Protect, Calm Mind): the user's own card is lit. Cursor can move before confirm (match02 T3 oppA->oppB, T4 oppA->oppB): final target = last lit card before panel closes; sample >=10 fps for this panel. A KO'd/empty slot card is grey (match02 t366).

result.note: WON!/LOST... split screen with trainer models; seen at t180+ in match01. Detect by big text in center; ROI TBD from more recordings.

waiting.note: 'Communicating...' + Poke Ball spinner, centre-top over battle scene, shown after own choices are locked until opponent finishes (match01 t~81.75-83.25). Marks end of own decision phase.

switch_menu.source: match02 t182-184 (after Espathra KO) and t241-246 (after Arcanine KO); presumably same widget for voluntary switch via Pokemon button (not seen yet)

own_rows.note: Party order = battle order (active slots first, then bench, then 2 greyed unbrought mons; match02 t242: Arcanine, Basculegion, Raichu, Espathra, Goodra, Floette). Exact HP cur/max for ALL own mons incl. 0/171 fainted (KO icon left). Cursor = lime row + yellow arrow.

opp_rows.note: Team-preview order. Revealed mons = bright pink with % (0% if fainted + KO icon); unrevealed = dark, no %. => authoritative opp HP snapshot + brought list each time this screen appears.

summary_panel.note: 'Moves & More' tab for the mon under cursor: 4 moves + PP, ability, held item. Second source for own move lists (live: read once per mon).

notes_ocr: Rec-only OCR (rapidocr use_det=False,use_cls=False) on fixed line ROIs: ~60 ms/crop, same quality as det+rec; match02 battle text+banners 313 s video in 126 s at 4 fps on 8 cores = real-time capable. Gate: skip crop if <60 near-white pixels.
